source.reference: A rename is a drop and an add as far as a running reader is concerned. The safe form is add / dual-write / backfill / switch reads / drop, documented in the same zero-downtime literature

defect: 0051 renames the column in a single statement while the previous release is still selecting the old name.
why_it_is_hard: It is one line, it is obviously what the ticket asked for, and the repository after the change is consistent. As with mig-002 the broken reader is a deployed version rather than a file — and unlike mig-002 the column is not gone, so a reviewer looking for DROP finds nothing.
